author: GamingBolt
description:
The Steam Machine has shed light on an interesting facet of console gaming: how lower console prices are recovered over their lifespans. But it’s also raised questions about open-ended versus close-ended systems, while making us think ahead to the PS6 and the next Xbox. 

Why is that the case? Well, that’s what we’re here to tell you about. We’re looking at potentially hefty price tags on the next generation of gaming consoles, with both the PS6 and Project Helix facing challenges that could hamper their ability to attract gamers to upgrade. Join us as we examine the underlying reasons and potential approaches the two giants can take to avoid obvious pitfalls.
title: PS6 And Xbox Helix Cannot Afford To Launch Into A $1,000 Console Market

author: GamingBolt
description:
We already knew 2026 was going to be a busy year, but we’ve been pleasantly surprised by what a good one it's been thanks to a bevy of games that kept us on the edge of our seats. From great stories to solid mechanical systems that we couldn’t get enough of, and some experiences that blended both into potent combinations, there’s been a lot to like in a year that’s looking like it's only getting started. 

Join us as we look back fondly at some of our personal favorites for this year, and perhaps see if one of them is a title that you missed while waiting for the rest of this year’s crowded calendar of releases ahead of the giant (GTA 6!) looming large on the horizon.
title: Top 10 MUST-PLAY Games of 2026 So Far
